{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}

module Main where

import Web.Scotty
import Data.Aeson (FromJSON, ToJSON, object, (.=))
import GHC.Generics (Generic)
import Data.IORef
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import Data.Text.Lazy (Text)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Control.Concurrent.MVar

type Address = String
type Balance = Integer
type PoolState = Map.Map String Integer

data LoanRequest = LoanRequest
  { loanAsset :: String
  , loanAmount :: Integer
  , callbackEndpoint :: String
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

instance FromJSON LoanRequest
instance ToJSON LoanRequest

data SwapRequest = SwapRequest
  { fromAsset :: String
  , toAsset :: String
  , swapAmount :: Integer
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

instance FromJSON SwapRequest
instance ToJSON SwapRequest

data AppState = AppState
  { poolReserves :: MVar PoolState
  , userBalances :: MVar (Map.Map Address (Map.Map String Integer))
  , flashLoanActive :: MVar Bool
  , loanOriginator :: MVar (Maybe Address)
  , outstandingLoan :: MVar Integer
  , snapshotReserves :: MVar PoolState
  }

initState :: IO AppState
initState = do
  pools <- newMVar $ Map.fromList [("ETH", 10000), ("USDC", 20000000), ("DAI", 20000000)]
  balances <- newMVar $ Map.fromList [("user1", Map.fromList [("ETH", 100), ("USDC", 50000)])]
  active <- newMVar False
  originator <- newMVar Nothing
  outstanding <- newMVar 0
  snapshot <- newMVar Map.empty
  return $ AppState pools balances active originator outstanding snapshot

-- Constant product AMM price calculation
getPrice :: Integer -> Integer -> Integer -> Integer
getPrice reserveIn reserveOut amountIn =
  let numerator = amountIn * reserveOut
      denominator = reserveIn + amountIn
  in numerator `div` denominator

-- Check invariant: k = x * y must not decrease
verifyInvariant :: PoolState -> PoolState -> Bool
verifyInvariant before after =
  let kBefore = computeK before
      kAfter = computeK after
  in kAfter >= kBefore

computeK :: PoolState -> Integer
computeK pools =
  let eth = fromMaybe 1 $ Map.lookup "ETH" pools
      usdc = fromMaybe 1 $ Map.lookup "USDC" pools
  in eth * usdc

-- Validates repayment within same transaction context
validateRepayment :: Integer -> Integer -> Integer -> Bool
validateRepayment borrowed repaid fee =
  repaid >= borrowed + fee

-- Calculate flash loan fee (0.09%)
calculateFee :: Integer -> Integer
calculateFee amount = max 1 (amount * 9 `div` 10000)

-- The swap uses SNAPSHOT state to prevent price manipulation during loan
executeSwap :: AppState -> String -> String -> Integer -> IO (Either String Integer)
executeSwap state from to amount = do
  isLoanActive <- readMVar (flashLoanActive state)
  pools <- takeMVar (poolReserves state)
  snapshot <- readMVar (snapshotReserves state)
  let pricingPools = if isLoanActive then snapshot else pools
      reserveFrom = fromMaybe 0 $ Map.lookup from pricingPools
      reserveTo = fromMaybe 0 $ Map.lookup to pricingPools
  if amount <= 0 || reserveFrom == 0 || reserveTo == 0
    then do
      putMVar (poolReserves state) pools
      return $ Left "Invalid swap parameters"
    else do
      let amountOut = getPrice reserveFrom reserveTo amount
          actualFrom = fromMaybe 0 $ Map.lookup from pools
          actualTo = fromMaybe 0 $ Map.lookup to pools
          newReserveFrom = actualFrom + amount
          newReserveTo = actualTo - amountOut
          newPools = Map.insert to newReserveTo $ Map.insert from newReserveFrom pools
      if amountOut <= 0 || newReserveTo <= 0
        then do
          putMVar (poolReserves state) pools
          return $ Left "Insufficient liquidity"
        else do
          -- Verify constant product invariant
          if not (verifyInvariant pools newPools)
            then do
              putMVar (poolReserves state) pools
              return $ Left "Invariant violation"
            else do
              putMVar (poolReserves state) newPools
              return $ Right amountOut

main :: IO ()
main = do
  state <- initState
  scotty 3000 $ do

    post "/flashloan" $ do
      req <- jsonData :: ActionM LoanRequest
      let amount = loanAmount req
          asset = loanAsset req
      result <- liftIO $ do
        active <- takeMVar (flashLoanActive state)
        if active
          then do
            putMVar (flashLoanActive state) active
            return False
          else do
            pools <- takeMVar (poolReserves state)
            -- Take snapshot BEFORE modifying reserves
            _ <- takeMVar (snapshotReserves state)
            putMVar (snapshotReserves state) pools
            let currentReserve = fromMaybe 0 $ Map.lookup asset pools
            if amount > currentReserve || amount <= 0
              then do
                putMVar (poolReserves state) pools
                putMVar (flashLoanActive state) False
                return False
              else do
                let newPools = Map.insert asset (currentReserve - amount) pools
                putMVar (poolReserves state) newPools
                _ <- takeMVar (outstandingLoan state)
                putMVar (outstandingLoan state) amount
                putMVar (flashLoanActive state) True
                return True
      if result
        then json $ object ["status" .= ("loan_disbursed" :: String), "amount" .= amount]
        else json $ object ["error" .= ("loan_rejected" :: String)]

    post "/swap" $ do
      req <- jsonData :: ActionM SwapRequest
      result <- liftIO $ executeSwap state (fromAsset req) (toAsset req) (swapAmount req)
      case result of
        Left err -> json $ object ["error" .= err]
        Right out -> json $ object ["received" .= out]

    post "/repay" $ do
      amount <- jsonData :: ActionM Integer
      result <- liftIO $ do
        outstanding <- takeMVar (outstandingLoan state)
        let fee = calculateFee outstanding
        if validateRepayment outstanding amount fee
          then do
            pools <- takeMVar (poolReserves state)
            snapshot <- readMVar (snapshotReserves state)
            let ethReserve = fromMaybe 0 $ Map.lookup "ETH" pools
            let newPools = Map.insert "ETH" (ethReserve + amount) pools
            -- Verify pool health against pre-loan snapshot
            if verifyInvariant snapshot newPools
              then do
                putMVar (poolReserves state) newPools
                _ <- takeMVar (flashLoanActive state)
                putMVar (flashLoanActive state) False
                putMVar (outstandingLoan state) 0
                return True
              else do
                putMVar (poolReserves state) pools
                putMVar (outstandingLoan state) outstanding
                return False
          else do
            putMVar (outstandingLoan state) outstanding
            return False
      if result
        then json $ object ["status" .= ("repaid" :: String)]
        else json $ object ["error" .= ("repayment_failed" :: String)]

    get "/reserves" $ do
      pools <- liftIO $ readMVar (poolReserves state)
      json pools
